course.title: Transport Phenomena in Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Consider one dimensional, steady state heat flow along two stainless steel bars $( k = 2 0$ $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { . \circ } \mathrm { C } )$ , each of diameter D = 2 cm, length $\mathrm { L } = 3$ cm and pressed together with a pressure of 10 atm. The surface has a roughness of about 2.5 μm. An overall temperature difference of $\Delta \mathrm { T } = 1 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ is applied across the bars. The interface temperature is about $9 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ The contact conductance of the interface is $h _ { c } = 3 0 0 0 \mathrm { \ W / m } ^ { 2 . \mathrm { o } } \mathrm { C }$ . Calculate the heat flow rate along the bars. Calculate the temperature drop at the interface.
